verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented guided first-time setup, setup wizard, or end-user walkthrough for registering a YubiKey with accounts. The available docs are developer guides (passkey backends, SDKs, SSH/PIV/PGP), the ykman configuration CLI, and a passing mention of the Yubico Authenticator GUI for checking firmware version. Community feedback says novices can miss key guidance, such as setting a PIN before enrolling, which suggests setup is not well guided.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts
